messages:
sam (releases): Starting canary deploy for release v2.8.1 now. Plan: enable feature flag 'llm-routing' at 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~30m. Change window until 18:45 UTC. Ping @grace for rollback rules. Release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/v2.8.1 :rocket:
deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.8.1 canary: initializing
```
deploy --release v2.8.1 --canary 5% --flags llm-routing=true
```
grace (eng-platform): Ack. Dashboards up, synthetic tests running. Alert thresholds: error rate >1% or p95 latency +30% => pause and evaluate. If triggered, prefer region-scoped rollback. @rita FYI on pager rules.
rita (sre): Oncall + watching. I'll escalate if SLOs breach. Can someone drop the canary metrics here?
deploy-bot: Canary @5% complete. Metrics snapshot: p95 latency=62ms, error_rate=0.2%, qps=120. No anomalies.
sam (releases): Ramping to 20% now.
deploy-bot: Initiating ramp to 20% (expected complete in ~4m).
```
deploy --set-canary 20% --release v2.8.1
```
mike (eng): Seeing a slight uptick on rerank service errors in eu-west-1: +0.9% baseline -> 0.9% additional. Correlates with requests routed to new model variant. Not past threshold yet but flagging.
grace (eng-platform): Hold at 20% until we validate rerank. Can we pin percentages by region? Prefer US stay at 20%, EU back to 5% for now. @sam? :thinking_face:
sam (releases): Yes. Pinning by-region now. Applying routing override.
```
# routing overrides
{"llm-routing": {"percent_by_region": {"us": 20, "eu": 5, "apac": 5}}}
```
deploy-bot: Routing config update applied: llm-routing: us=20 eu=5 apac=5.
rita (sre): Monitoring EU closely. If eu-west-1 error >1% for 5m => rollback EU only.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (eu-west-1, last 5m): error_rate=1.3% ↑ (breach). Pausing rollout and raising alert. :rotating_light:
sam (releases): Pausing global ramp. Rolling back EU region to v2.8.0 and disabling llm-routing flag in EU. @deploy-bot run rollback --region eu-west-1 --to v2.8.0
deploy-bot: Executing region rollback...
```
rollback --region eu-west-1 --to v2.8.0 --flags-disable llm-routing
> stopping canary traffic to eu-west-1
> routing update applied
> health checks passing
> rollback complete (eu-west-1)
```
grace (eng-platform): Good call. Keep US at 20% for 15m extra and watch for secondary effects. If rerank errors persist, schedule a short postmortem and revert model variant.
tom (product): Heads-up for comms: we should add a note to the release notes and customer status page about partial rollback in EU. Keep messaging clear that US unaffected.
sam (releases): Drafting note: "Partial rollback in EU due to increased rerank errors after llm-routing enablement; US rollout continues at 20% while we investigate." Will link to incident if needed.
rita (sre): Created incident ticket INC-4821 and attached traces + logs: https://redwood-internal/incident/INC-4821. Assigning to @mike and @grace for triage.
mike (eng): I'll start bisecting model variant changes and check quantization mismatch in rerank path.
sam (releases): Thanks team. :thumbsup: Closing this thread unless new alerts come in.
